<p class="page-intro">I am a master's student in Biostatistics at Columbia University's Mailman School of Public Health.</p>

In P8105 Data Science, I work with R to clean and combine data, explore patterns,
and write reproducible reports. My course projects have included public health,
weather, transportation, and store availability data.
